scope: 118 P51 priority candidates after P53 15 reuse, P50 7 overlap, P52/P53 5 exact church checks and P53 5 earlier false-feature holds
source_hierarchy: Catholic custodian/diocese for religious identity; named OSM way and tags for exact physical geometry; natural/civic feature context only for scope exclusions; manual screening combines fresh retrieved map material with P51 source material, and therefore does not certify fresh live retrieval for every item.
quality_controls: Research-only: direct feature-name match does not equal certified release-ready physical geometry.
P51 previously carried sources are NEVER treated as independently reviewed in P54 unless listed in P54 individual review.
Distinguish adjacent basilicas/chapels, shared relics and precints; do not publish localities, parks, castles, religious land use or other confessions as a Catholic church.
No photographs, artwork, permissions or expenses.
Previous 349 unresolved working-acquisition leads remain unchanged until further exact matching or new separately validated publication.

The 32 individually classified cases were not all independently re-fetched: classification uses a mix of fresh searches and existing reviewed source evidence. Never count them as 32 newly verified live sites.
